rundown: Warriors beat Pelicans 138-87 at Chase Center in San Francisco, CA in front of 18,064. Warriors led 72-43 at the half and never looked back. The 3rd quarter decided it: Warriors won it 40-22. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 74%).
Leading the way — Pelicans: Derik Queen 16 pts; Jeremiah Fears 8 ast; Herbert Jones 6 reb. Warriors: Stephen Curry 25 pts; Al Horford 6 ast; Charles Bassey 10 reb.
Where Warriors won it: they shot 55% to 36%, shot 48% from three to 29% and won the boards 50-31.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Warriors closed as 10.5-point favorites and covered by 40.5; the total closed at 228.5 and they combined for 225, under by 3.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 9, 9:55 PM ET. It had Pelicans 19% and Warriors 81%, projecting Pelicans 114.8 – Warriors 125.1 (239.9 total, Warriors by 10.3).

Final: Pelicans 87 – Warriors 138. Right winner: it had Warriors at 81%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Pelicans came in with a 2% above average attack and a 4% leakier than average defense (4-6, 120.5 scored and 120.8 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 44 and 44 games of evidence. Projected to score 114.8, they scored 87 (−27.8 points, 24% under); projected to allow 125.1, they allowed 138 (+12.9 points, 10% over).

Warriors came in with a 2% above average attack and a league-average defense (7-3, 118.6 scored and 113.6 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 44 and 44 games of evidence. Projected to score 125.1, they scored 138 (+12.9 points, 10% over); projected to allow 114.8, they allowed 87 (−27.8 points, 24% under).

The bigger miss was Pelicans' scoring (-27.8 points against projection).
